content.title: CWD digest: Disease reaches new areas in Wyoming, Wisconsin, as Michigan detects case on farm
content.abstract: The fatal neurologic disease was identified in Deer Hunt Area 141 in Wyoming, Marinette County in Wisconsin, and a farm in Michigan’s Hillsdale County.
